top_signals.title: Turkey to Start Payments to Investors Caught in Fund Crisis
top_signals.summary: Turkey’s markets regulator ordered interim payments of as much as 1 million liras ($20,400) to investors whose money has been trapped in some funds being liquidated as authorities try to contain a crisis that has shaken the country’s financial markets.

top_signals.title: UK house price growth halves as mortgage rates weigh on demand
top_signals.summary: UK house prices rose at their slowest rate since December last month as expensive mortgages and uncertainty ahead of the Autumn Budget fuelled caution among buyers.
